tasks.check: deno fmt --check src deno.json styles docs README.md README.zh-Hans.md README.zh-Hant.md && deno lint src && deno check src/cli.ts && deno run --allow-read --allow-env src/cli.ts check
tasks.public:check: deno check scripts/public-check.ts && deno lint scripts/public-check.ts && deno run --allow-read scripts/public-check.ts
tasks.public:prepare: deno task check && deno task public:test && deno task public:check && deno run --allow-read --allow-write=Local scripts/public-check.ts --export
tasks.test: deno test --allow-read --allow-write --allow-run --allow-env src/kit_test.ts tests/public_check_test.ts tests/admin_test.ts src/safe_output_test.ts tests/backup_guard_test.ts tests/corner_alpha_test.ts
